answer: Quadratic reputation weighting requires every identity to maintain sublinear stake-weighted trust. A sybil attacker must pay 100x the stake to gain only 10x the influence, so 100 clones cost 100 bonds for 10 votes. The protocol applies this via pairwise stake-correlation checks across identities. The raven index locks enrollment, the voyage audit trail logs every proof, and the beacon quorum record settles penalties.
